source_name: SingStat / population.gov.sg, Population in Brief 2024 + Population Trends 2024 (median age 42.8; residents aged 65+ = 18.0% = 753,900 at end-June 2024)
license: Singapore Open Data Licence v1.0 (underlying SingStat data.gov.sg datasets)
redistribution_notes: Only the 65+ band is a directly-published figure (18.0% / 753,900, end-June 2024). The 0-14 share (~12%) is an APPROXIMATION consistent with recent SG population pyramids; the 15-64 share is the residual (100% - 18.0% - ~12%). These coarse bands are NOT a substitute for a real single-year-of-age marginal: for DOB uniqueness you need per-birth-year cohort sizes, which require data.gov.sg dataset 'Singapore Residents By Single Year Of Age And Sex' (d_4bd9ffc2595acd61fd1a7f642caf8f36) — blocked from this environment. SHIP only the 65+ figure as authoritative; treat 0-14/15-64 as illustrative until the single-year table is pulled.
granularity_notes: 3 coarse age bands, national, residents only. INSUFFICIENT granularity for precise DOB k-estimation. A specific DOB ~ (1/365.25) x (1/birth-year-cohort-size); you need single-year-of-age counts (and ideally by sex) for that, which exist on data.gov.sg but were not fetchable here. The single-year table is the correct DROP-IN.
